title: Weak Segmentation-Guided GAN for~Realistic Color Edition
abstract: arXiv:2610.16620v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Editing the color of images in a realistic way finds many applications such as changing the perception of an image, data augmentation or film post processing. The design of an automatic tool is a complex and long addressed challenge. In particular, two properties are difficult to meet altogether: generating realistic results without artifacts and the possibility to precisely choose the future color. Conventional methods using segmentation and histogram matching maximize the controllability but also introduce a lack of realism or are complex to automate. On the contrary, GANs that specialize in realism are difficult to control. To overcome these challenges, we propose a novel GAN architecture leveraging any differentiable segmentation model. We demonstrate the genericness of our framework that presents state of the art results on different use cases. It generates images that look realistic while offering a precise color control.

translated_title: 弱分割引导的生成对抗网络用于真实感色彩编辑
translated_abstract: 以真实的方式编辑图像颜色有着广泛的应用，例如改变图像的观感、数据增强或电影后期处理。设计一个自动化工具是一个复杂且长期存在的挑战。特别是，有两个特性很难同时满足：生成无伪影的真实感结果，以及能够精确选择目标颜色。使用分割和直方图匹配的传统方法虽然最大化了可控性，但也带来了真实感的缺失，或者难以自动化。相反，专注于真实感的GAN则难以控制。为了克服这些挑战，我们提出了一种新颖的GAN架构，它可以利用任何可微分的分割模型。我们展示了该框架的通用性，在不同的应用场景中均取得了最先进的结果。它生成的图像看起来真实，同时提供精确的颜色控制。
tldr: 提出一种可利用任意可微分分割模型的弱分割引导GAN架构，在实现精确颜色控制的同时生成真实无伪影的图像。
en_tdlr: Proposes a novel weak segmentation-guided GAN architecture that leverages any differentiable segmentation model to generate realistic, artifact-free images while providing precise color control.
